title: EvaluatorDefinition (rubric)
description: Rubric for judging an attempt (ADR-0007, ADR-0013). Deterministic observations are the activity's own checks; this rubric declares what the LLM evaluator judges on top of those facts. Identified in evaluation.completed by id + document hash. The LLM implementation, prompt and model are the manifest's registry.evaluator. A rubric without 'semantic' is deterministic-only (required for holdout, ADR-0011). Withheld from the learner and from the tutor during an unfinished attempt: guidance may name the expected root cause.

id.description: Evidence dimension, from the skill's evidence_dimensions vocabulary.

guidance.description: What distinguishes systematic diagnosis from lucky success, hint dependence, unnecessary changes, etc.

misconceptions.description: Misconception vocabulary the evaluator and learner model may report (skill-state misconceptions tokens).
